servinfo.title: Vehicle Identification Number
servinfo.ptxt: The number (1) is inscribed on the right dash side of front panel in engine compartment.
The number (2) is also attached on the left side of cowl top panel depending on vehicle specification.
The label (3) inscribed with the number is also attached on rear floor panel depending on vehicle specification.
The label (4) inscribed with the number is also attached on CVT assembly depending on vehicle specification.
